description: Attach or replace the receipt or invoice file of an existing expense, and optionally set vendor and invoiceNumber. Send either fileBase64 with mimeType (PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 3 MB) or an https url (up to 10 MB, public hosts only, no redirects). The file is stored like receipts uploaded in the app.
name: attach_expense_receipt
title: Attach expense receipt
